#!/usr/bin/env bash
# One dry-hump live pass: 8 domains × 8 concurrent Titanium sparks via sekhmet.
# Args: <run_id> <out_dir> [model_label]
set -euo pipefail
RUN_ID=${1:?run_id}
OUT=${2:?out_dir}
MODEL_LABEL=${3:-unknown}
export PATH="${HOME}/.cargo/bin:${PATH}"
export CODEX_BIN=${CODEX_BIN:-$(command -v codex-titanium || command -v codex)}
HERE=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
DOMAINS=(religion sex drugs politics money violence ai charlie-kirk)
ROOT=$(mktemp -d "/tmp/sekhmet-12x-${RUN_ID}-XXXXXX")
mkdir -p "$OUT"
META="$OUT/meta.json"
START_ISO=$(date -u -Iseconds)
START_EPOCH=$(date +%s.%N)
HOST=$(hostname 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
SEK=$(command -v sekhmet)
CODEX_VER=$("$CODEX_BIN" --version 2>&1 | head -1 || true)

for d in "${DOMAINS[@]}"; do
  mkdir -p "$ROOT/$d"
  (
    DS=$(date +%s.%N)
    sekhmet swarm --direct -j 8 --timeout 180 \
      --tasks-file "$HERE/domains/$d/tasks.txt" \
      --root "$ROOT/$d" \
      > "$ROOT/$d/ndjson.out" \
      2> "$ROOT/$d/stderr.log"
    EC=$?
    DE=$(date +%s.%N)
    echo "exit=$EC start=$DS end=$DE" > "$ROOT/$d/timing.txt"
    exit $EC
  ) &
done
wait
END_EPOCH=$(date +%s.%N)
END_ISO=$(date -u -Iseconds)

# Aggregate ok/fail + tokens from result.json
python3 - "$ROOT" "$OUT" "$RUN_ID" "$MODEL_LABEL" "$START_EPOCH" "$END_EPOCH" "$START_ISO" "$END_ISO" "$HOST" "$SEK" "$CODEX_BIN" "$CODEX_VER" <<'PY'
import json, glob, os, re, sys
root, out, run_id, model, s, e, si, ei, host, sek, cbin, cver = sys.argv[1:13]
pat = re.compile(r"tokens used[^\d\n]*\n?\s*([\d,]+)", re.I)
domains = "religion sex drugs politics money violence ai charlie-kirk".split()
total_ok=total_fail=total_timeout=total_lines=0
tokens=[]
by={}
for d in domains:
    nd=os.path.join(root,d,"ndjson.out")
    ok=fail=timeout=lines=0
    dtok=[]
    if os.path.isfile(nd):
        for line in open(nd):
            line=line.strip()
            if not line: continue
            lines+=1
            try:
                v=json.loads(line)
            except Exception:
                continue
            st=v.get("status")
            if st=="ok": ok+=1
            elif st=="timeout": timeout+=1
            else: fail+=1
    # tokens from result.json
    for rf in glob.glob(os.path.join(root,d,"sp-*","out","result.json")):
        r=json.load(open(rf))
        text=(r.get("stderr") or "")+"\n"+(r.get("stdout") or "")
        m=pat.search(text)
        if m:
            t=int(m.group(1).replace(",",""))
            tokens.append(t); dtok.append(t)
    timing=open(os.path.join(root,d,"timing.txt")).read().strip() if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(root,d,"timing.txt")) else ""
    by[d]={"ok":ok,"fail":fail,"timeout":timeout,"lines":lines,
           "tokens_sum":sum(dtok),"tokens_n":len(dtok),"timing":timing}
    total_ok+=ok; total_fail+=fail; total_timeout+=timeout; total_lines+=lines

wall=float(e)-float(s)
summary={
  "run_id": run_id,
  "model_label": model,
  "wall_seconds": round(wall,3),
  "start_iso": si,
  "end_iso": ei,
  "start_epoch": s,
  "end_epoch": e,
  "host": host,
  "sekhmet_bin": sek,
  "codex_bin": cbin,
  "codex_version": cver,
  "root": root,
  "sparks_expected": 64,
  "sparks_ok": total_ok,
  "sparks_fail": total_fail,
  "sparks_timeout": total_timeout,
  "ndjson_lines": total_lines,
  "tokens_total": sum(tokens),
  "tokens_n": len(tokens),
  "tokens_min": min(tokens) if tokens else None,
  "tokens_max": max(tokens) if tokens else None,
  "tokens_avg": round(sum(tokens)/len(tokens),1) if tokens else None,
  "domains": by,
}
open(os.path.join(out,"summary.json"),"w").write(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+"\n")
# human one-liner
print(json.dumps({
  "run_id": run_id, "model": model, "wall_s": summary["wall_seconds"],
  "ok": total_ok, "fail": total_fail, "timeout": total_timeout,
  "tokens": summary["tokens_total"], "root": root
}))
PY
